title: Neostellar’s Willy Lee on AI Landscape Ahead of Anthropic Pre-IPO Investor Day
text: Willy Lee, Principal at Neostellar, says attention on Anthropic’s potential IPO risks obscuring broader AI investment and adoption. He cited nearly $200 billion in U.S. venture capital deployed in the first half of the year—more than 74% of the prior year’s estimated total. He speaks with Scarlet Fu & Hema Parmar on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
